documented: Docker documents PATs as password-equivalent authentication secrets, including use by automated systems.
The Docker Hub OpenAPI create-access-token request demonstrates the dckr_pat_ prefix.
assumptions: The 27-character alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen body is the Titus v1.2.9 scanner constraint, not a provider-published width or generator contract.
Bare values are detectable without a username; upstream login-verifier pairing is not part of offline detection.
Unprefixed historical UUID-like tokens and differently typed dckr_oat_ tokens are excluded from this PAT rule.

The native left word boundary and catalogRightBoundary reject word-adjacent starts and partial matches before credential-alphabet suffixes; this is a detection boundary policy, not an issuance guarantee.
No entropy floor, arbitrary digit count, checksum, cryptographic validation or verifier/network calls are imported.
evidence.fixture_method: Deterministic synthetic sequences authored independently of scanner/provider example credentials. Bare and value-contained carried positives, width/alphabet/case/adjacency mutations, revision exclusions and public identifiers exercise offline candidate detection only. No live keys, randomness, external verification, attribute names or decoding.

Preserve the historical 40-character scanner subset and add the current 53-character documented masked-example width. assumptions: Opaque body alphabets and widths are supported scanner subsets, not exhaustive issuer grammars or proof of validity.

documented: CircleCI explicitly specifies CCIPAT_<base58-UUID>_<40-char-hex string> and distinguishes personal CCIPAT from project CCIPRJ tokens.
The official example contains a 22-character base58 UUID segment; personal tokens authenticate API requests.
assumptions: The first segment uses the conventional base58 alphabet; its fixed 22-character width is supported by the official example and pinned TruffleHog scanner, not a published complete UUID-serialization algorithm.
Titus sample-position restrictions and alphanumeric final body are deliberately not copied: no positions are forced to be digits or letters, and the documented final segment is hexadecimal.
Hexadecimal letter case is accepted in either case; no UUID numeric range, UUID version, checksum or issuance claim is made.

documented: Figma documents personal access tokens as giving the holder API access as the issuing user, with X-Figma-Token as the carrier.
Figma documents scoped and historical token revisions, but does not publish a complete figp_ token grammar in the consulted primary guides.
assumptions: The supported figp_ prefix and 40-54 character alphanumeric/underscore/equals/hyphen body are explicitly the pinned TruffleHog v3.97.4 v3 scanner contract, not a provider specification.
The regex does not inherit the malformed historical v2 character-class alternatives or presume support for figd_ or OAuth revisions.
Equals and hyphen are body characters, including at the end; an end word boundary would truncate or miss these candidates. No base64 padding validity or internal encoding is assumed.
